name: icon
description: Classes that style a <span> or <i> as an icon from an icon font, or a <span> around an inline SVG. CSS only: no component and no screen reader handling.

props.name: Material Symbols: write the name as the text and add material-symbols-outlined. Other fonts: add the font's classes, like ph ph-smiley.
props.svg: Add icon--svg and put an inline <svg> inside.
props.label: None. Add aria-hidden or aria-label by hand.
props.size: Add icon--small, icon--medium, icon--large, or icon--x-large by hand. Medium is the default.
props.weight: Add icon--weight-light, icon--weight-normal, icon--weight-semi-bold, or icon--weight-bold by hand.
props.emphasis: Add icon--low-emphasis, icon--normal-emphasis, or icon--high-emphasis by hand.
props.filled: Add icon--filled or icon--outlined by hand.

modifiers.icon--small: The small font size and optical size
modifiers.icon--large: The large font size and optical size
modifiers.icon--x-large: The 2x-large font size and optical size
modifiers.icon--weight-thin: Phosphor only, from the Phosphor addon. Not in icon.css
modifiers.icon--weight-light: Light font weight, stroke width 1 on SVG
modifiers.icon--weight-normal: Normal font weight, stroke width 1.5 on SVG
modifiers.icon--weight-semi-bold: Semi-bold font weight, stroke width 2 on SVG
modifiers.icon--weight-bold: Bold font weight, stroke width 2.5 on SVG
modifiers.icon--svg: Sizes an inline SVG to fill the icon box

customPropertiesNote: Public variables use the --_op-icon-* prefix and hold one value per modifier. Modifiers copy a value into a private --__op-icon-* variable. The font axes are set by the separate .material-symbols-outlined class, so another font class does not get them. The icon has no color variable and inherits the text color.

icon.--_op-icon-weight-normal: Font weight for icon--weight-normal and the default
icon.--_op-icon-fill-outlined: FILL for icon--outlined and the default
icon.--_op-icon-emphasis-normal: GRAD for icon--normal-emphasis and the default
icon.--_op-icon-font-size-medium: Size for icon--medium and the default
icon.--_op-icon-optical-size-medium: opsz for icon--medium and the default
